d: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller.  After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.
While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe or beyond suspicion.

The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.
The story takes place in modern day Bucharest and tells the tale of nineteen year old Vivian Gandillon, who has spent her life on the run from the truth that she is a werewolf.

Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller.  After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

After a terrible boating accident killed her family, shy Angela Baker is sent to Camp Arawak. Shortly after her arrival a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.
